text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) froze on Tuesday for the fourth straight session the rise in the prices of Itogon Suyoc Mines Inc A and B shares.
Itogon has informed the exchange that it does not know of any material information that is affecting the surge in its price.
The PSE surveillance department said that Itogon A and B shares were both frozen at 16.50 centavos, a 50 percent rise from their 11 centavo close on Monday.
Traders said investors have been buying up tertiary stocks on market rumours of buy-ins and backdoor listings.
"When its a sleepy market, local investors tend to focus and play on tertiary stocks," said Felix Barrientos, sales dealer at ING Barings.
The bourse automatically stops the rise in prices of shares which have climbed by or close to 50 percent within a single trading day. The PSE has frozen Itogon Suyoc shares every day since Thursday.
